rows.note: Use 還原 as the all-purpose choice when undo means restoring something to its previous state or reversing an effect.

example.english: I accidentally deleted the document; can I still undo it?
example.traditional: 我唔小心刪咗份文件，仲可以還原返嗎？
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 saan1 zo2 fan6 man4 gin2 zung6 ho2 ji5 waan4 jyun4 faan1 maa3

rows.note: Use 解開 when undo means unfastening a buckle, knot, button, or similar fastening.

example.english: Can you undo my shoelaces first? I can't walk.
example.traditional: 你幫我解開條鞋帶先，我行唔到。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 gaai2 hoi1 tiu4 haai4 daai2 sin1 ngo5 haang4 m4 dou2
